title: Northwind Portal
subtitle: Getting started: sign in and submit your first request
intro: Welcome to the Northwind Portal. In this quick guide, you'll learn how to sign in, find your way around the dashboard, and submit your first request.
outro_sub: Questions? Contact the IT support team.
outro: And that's it! You're ready to start using the Northwind Portal. If you have any questions, just reach out to the IT support team.

beats.say: Start by opening the portal's login page in your browser.
Click the Work email field, and type your company email address.
Next, enter your password. For your security, it will appear as dots.
Once you're signed in, you'll land on your dashboard.
At the top, these cards give you a quick summary of all your requests.
Below them, you'll find your most recent requests, along with their current status.
You can use the menu on the left to move between the different sections of the portal.
To create something new, click the New request button.
This opens the new request form.
First, give your request a short, clear title.
Then add a few details in the description, so your manager knows exactly what you need.
beats.text: Laptop for our new designer, who starts on Monday.

beats.say: Choose the request type and the priority level.
When everything looks good, click Submit request.
You'll see a confirmation message, letting you know your request was sent.
And your new request now appears at the top of the list, waiting for approval.
